V. 16.
Then let them who are in Judea, ſ•e to the mountains—So the Chriſtians did, and were preſerved. It is remarkable, that after the Romans under Ceſtius Gallas, made their firſt Advance towards Jeruſalem, they ſuddenly withdrew again, in a moſt unexpected and indeed impolitic Manner. This the Chriſtians took as a Signal to retire, which they did, ſome to Pella, and others to Mount Libanus.
